legacy_refresh_trigger.checked_when: Obtaining a device token for a request
legacy_refresh_trigger.concurrency: Shared monitor, with cached-token check repeated inside lock
legacy_refresh_trigger.clock_fallback: For the identical cached token, elapsedRealtime in [refresh receipt, refresh receipt + 90% issued lifetime) can still validate the token if the wall-clock check fails.
legacy_refresh_trigger.reactive_error: HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate exactly CLIENT_DEVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN_INVALID, when device authentication is configured. Refresh handler then propagates original request error at the inspected call site.

acquisition_retry.scope: Normal token-acquisition wrapper only; not an HTTP retry guarantee for every call.

ktor_refresh_trigger.after_success: Attach replacement Access-Token and retry original request
ktor_refresh_trigger.concurrency: Atomic shared deferred refresh and token-version tracking
ktor_refresh_trigger.retry_guard: Remove selected provider from attempt set; retried request receives internal auth-request marker

user_key: No USER_KEY setter in inspected refresh path; lifetime remains unestablished.
failure_behavior: Missing stored refresh token or caught remote/storage failure returns no replacement pair; successful live renewal has not been tested.
